name: Dormant customer win-back
description: Reconnects with a former customer after a period of inactivity, starting with their current situation rather than immediately pitching.
audience: Former customers who stopped using the product around six months ago.

variants: Hi {{firstName|there}} — noticed {{company|your team}} previously used {{product|our product}}. Thought I'd reach out and reconnect.
Hi {{firstName|there}}, saw that {{company|your team}} worked with us before on {{product|the product}}. It would be good to reconnect.
Thanks for connecting. It's been a while since {{company|your team}} used {{product|the product}}. Curious how things have been going since then.
Appreciate the connection, {{firstName|there}}. I wanted to hear how things have changed at {{company|your company}} since you last used {{product|the product}}.
We've made some changes since then, but I'd rather understand your current needs first. Would you be open to a conversation?
There have been a few changes since you last used {{product|the product}}. If relevant, I'd be interested in hearing what you're looking for now.
